title: Harris's career path from Henry Harden to Papa Celestin
summary: Harris runs through his bands: Henry Harden, Kid Clayton, Kid Rena, Smiling Joe, his own band at the Palace and Doudrop, then Celestin in Florida.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: George, do you remember the first band you played with?
The first band I played with, the big band I played was Henry Harden.
And the little band. You played the band before Henry Harden. Kid Clayton. Yeah, because you was playing some saxophones and you was playing Henry Harden.
Kid Clayton. I was playing with Kid Clayton band when I left Kid Clayton band. I think I went with you all.

With Kid René after Jiu-Jitsu 2. And I left Kid René, I went in the French quarters at the crib was doing with Smiling Jew. And when I left Smiling Jew, I think I went to the Palace Theatre. I had my own band at the Palace Theatre.
And you went to the Budweiser?

Yeah, I went to the Budweiser, taxi dance. Yes, I remember that. Yeah, I played at the taxi dance or whatever and I left there. And I think I went to the Gypsy Tea Room. Not the Gypsy Tea Room. The Red Old Town? No, the...

On the South Street. Doudrop. Oh yeah. I went to Doudrop. Well I had my own band there. I had eight pieces there. And I stayed there about two years and I left there. And then I went with Celestan Tuxedo.
Traveled all to the state of Florida with Celestan. I stayed about four years with him and when I came back, I joined D. Vathomies Band.
Yeah, about when was that when you were with Celestan?
I was with Celestan exactly around 44 and 45. I think it was around 44 and 45.
That's before he went on Bourbon Street there.

Oh yeah, that was way before he went on. See, before he went on Bourbon Street he had got in an accident. Yes, that's right. I remember his knee. He got in an accident. Well I just had left the band when he got in that accident. Just had left the band.
